editorial.blurb: This warm, inviting Southern Italian gem delivers authentic Puglian flavors with a friendly spirit and a lovely patio for summer dining.
editorial.insiderTip: Go during happy hour for exceptional value, or arrive a bit before dinner time to get seated without a reservation—family-style ordering lets you sample more dishes.
